proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C18.md Theorem 7, triangular composition of row and column bijections); quality of the cascades measured separately (EXP-C18-05)
statement: In the cascade QC(T, d) (d e-transformations run in parallel, output = the final state of every pass), the update of the state (s_1, ..., s_d) by one input byte is a bijection of Q^d; so states are never merged and the tail-information bound does not apply to the output.
title: The 8-pass cascade has a bijective 64-bit state update
